description: This file defines a utility class TokenizeTool with a method to encrypt a string using AES encryption with a generated DES key, including logging for key generation errors.

classes.name: TokenizeTool
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to tokenize (encrypt) strings using AES encryption.

methods.name: tokenizeString
methods.description: Encrypts the input string using AES encryption and returns the ciphertext as a string.
